body: Implement bin/board.mjs for the [[panes]] overlay entrypoint per docs/herdr-integration-plan.md section 5.2. Zero-dep ANSI TUI rendering: backlog list from the sharded ticket store via @adlc/core (filter completed:true — repo invariant #104) grouped ready/in-flight/blocked-by-edges; the ticket-to-pane mapping published by the watcher; the most recent gate-evidence records per ticket from .adlc/manifest.jsonl. Read-only in v1 (no row actions). Every rendered string passes through lib/sanitize.mjs. Probe the [[panes]] stdin/resize/exit contract with a hello-world pane first (plan open question 2) and record the probed facts in the plugin README. Verification: node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/board.test.mjs. allow-suppression: none
title: herdr board pane v1: backlog, ticket-to-pane mapping, gate ledger
